scope_matrix_metadata.labor_estimate_basis: Technician minutes per 1,000 sq ft of conditioned space for one technician. Divide by team size for on-site duration.

kitchen: Wipe exterior cabinet faces and drawer pulls
Sanitize countertops and backsplash with OxyPure
Clean and polish exterior stainless steel appliances
Scrub sink basin, aerator, and faucet fixture
Vacuum and damp-mop hard surface floors
bathrooms: Scrub shower tile grout and sanitize fiberglass tubs
Disinfect toilet bowl, tank, base, and flush lever (Bio-Shield, 10 minute wet dwell)
Polish vanity mirrors and clean medicine cabinet fronts
Wipe down light fixtures and exhaust fan covers
living_areas_and_bedrooms: Dust all reachable surfaces, shelves, and décor
Vacuum carpets and rugs with HEPA-filtered vacuum
Damp-mop hardwood with PureLoom, mop dry immediately
Make beds if linens are left out

guest_readiness: Strip and launder bed linens and towels with hypoallergenic wash
Make beds to hotel hospital-corner standard
Restock guest amenities (botanical soaps, organic coffee pods)
Sanitize high-touch surfaces (remotes, keypad deadbolts, thermostats)
Inspect under furniture and in closets for left-behind guest property
kitchen: Empty and wipe refrigerator, discard guest food
Run dishwasher, put away dishes, and sanitize sink
bathrooms: Descale fixtures with Citrus-Loom (5 minute dwell) on sealed surfaces only
reporting: Photograph the completed property and any damage
Report low inventory and maintenance issues within 1 hour of completion

workstations: Dust desks, monitors, and ledges (clients clear desktops)
Sanitize shared keyboards, phones, and high-touch items on request
restrooms: Disinfect toilets, urinals, sinks, and partitions (Bio-Shield, 10 minute wet dwell)
common_areas: Sanitize break room counters, sink, and appliance exteriors
Wipe conference tables and door handles
Spot clean glass and entry doors

phase_1_rough_debris_pass: Remove construction packaging, protective films, stickers, and tape residue
Scrape paint splatter with plastic blades
Rough sweep floors with HEPA capture
phase_2_high_to_low_hepa_vacuuming: HEPA vacuum ceiling joists, fans, HVAC diffusers, and light fixtures
HEPA vacuum door casings, window tracks, and cabinet tops
HEPA vacuum baseboards and floors (99.97% at 0.3 microns)
phase_3_wet_microfiber_sparkle_pass: Damp wipe all surfaces with 8-quadrant folded microfiber
Clean cabinet interiors, glass, and fixtures
Final HEPA vacuum and white-glove inspection (3 sample points per room)

exclusions: Biohazard, mold remediation, and asbestos or lead abatement
Exterior windows above the second floor
Cleaning of unsealed natural stone with acidic products
